metadata.case_name: ABID KHAN v. QUEEN WAN LTD

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: less heavy work, such as security guard, watchman, messenger

injuries.description: central posterior disc extrusion at L4/5 causing spinal stenosis with crowding of cauda equina
source: [central] posterior disc extrusion at L4/5 …… causing spinal stenosis with crowding of cauda equina
back and right knee injury resulting in prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5
back and right knee injury resulting in prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5 with back pain and numbness
back and right knee injury resulting in prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5
back and right knee injury resulting in prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5 with back pain and numbness
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg, unspecified

manifestations.description: always pain over my back and right knee
low back pain with left lower limb tightness sensation and bilateral lower limb numbness
walking tolerance about 15-20 minutes (sitting/walking aggravates pain)
could not sleep at night because of the pain
pins and needles sensation over posterior aspect of right thigh and posterior aspect of right lower leg
tenderness over entire low back on palpation
difficulty to bend right knee with more pain when straightening the leg
reduced range of trunk movements restricted by pain
presence of positive Waddell's signs and inconsistent straight leg raising tests

treatments_received: accident and emergency department assessment at Prince of Wales Hospital
22 sessions of physiotherapy at Kowloon Hospital
disectomy of L4/5 by minimal invasive surgical technique (4th May 2007)
convalescence at Tai Po Hospital from 9th May to 2nd June 2007
8 sessions of physiotherapy at Kowloon Hospital (12th June to 6th July 2007)
referral to Pain Clinic at Queen Elizabeth Hospital
facet joint injection to bilateral L3/4, L4/5, L5/S1 (30th July 2008)
treatments_future: possible repeat facet joint injection (offered but refused on 2nd October 2008)
possible injection into the muscles around the spinal nerves (QEH Pain Clinic consideration)

losses.description: Unable to walk without stick; limited walking and sitting tolerance (about 15-20 minutes); walk with stick and limping gait reported
Unable to return to pre-Accident job of loading and unloading heavy goods
